text_block_list.text:
Today presents a new opportunity to put
my
winning equation to the test.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Imperfect though it may yet be, I will complete it and use it to beat every single opponent I face.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And even if the probability of winning is
a mere
one percent, I still intend to beat
them.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I take it you're on my side?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Folks, it's time for the Kikuka Sho, the
final race
of the Classic Triple Crown!
Biwa Hayahide has
made her way to the
paddock now...
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Hm? So that's Бива Хаяхидэ? She looks
to be in
fantastic shape. Just what kind
of training did she
do to achieve such a
powerful physique?
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You'd better believe I've been
training
hard. I'm here to win.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
My winning equation is just what it
sounds like—a
formula for victory!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
